idea: Grocery Price Inflation Google Trends Spike Triggers Consumer Staples Rotation

data.source: Google Trends weekly search interest for 'grocery prices rising' and 'food cost increase'

behavior: Spikes in consumer searches about rising grocery costs correlate with inflation anxiety and willingness to shift spending toward budget staples brands and away from discretionary categories.

market_impact.rationale: Consumer staples (especially discount retailers and budget food brands) outperform when inflation concerns spike and consumers trade down from discretionary spending.

trade_logic.entry: When weekly Google Trends for 'grocery prices rising' exceeds 60-point threshold and rises 25+ points week-over-week
trade_logic.exit: After 3 weeks or when search interest falls below 40-point threshold for 2 consecutive weeks

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Grocery price concerns spike multiple times per year during supply chain disruptions and inflation cycles; search behavior is highly correlated with CPI announcements and seasonal demand surges.

idea: Hotel Occupancy Rate Drop Signals Travel Sector Weakness Rotation

data.source: STR Global hotel occupancy rates published weekly via public html_table scrape from hospitality research indices

behavior: Sharp weekly declines in U.S. hotel occupancy rates signal weakening business and leisure travel demand, indicating consumer pullback on discretionary travel spending.

market_impact.rationale: Hotels, airlines, and cruise operators (consumer discretionary) underperform when occupancy drops, signaling demand destruction in travel and hospitality verticals.

trade_logic.entry: When weekly occupancy rate drops 5+ percentage points from 4-week average and falls below seasonal median for that week
trade_logic.exit: After 2 weeks or when occupancy recovers to 4-week average + 2 points

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Hotel occupancy swings 3–8% week-to-week due to seasonal variation, economic shocks, and competitor pricing; triggers occur 2–3 times per quarter.

idea: Initial Jobless Claims Spike Above 4-Week Average Signals Labor Weakness Rotation

data.source: FRED series A4001 (Initial Claims) weekly via fred_series adapter

behavior: Weekly jobless claims that spike 15%+ above the 4-week moving average signal deteriorating labor market health and rising unemployment risk, triggering defensive sector rotation.

market_impact.rationale: Rising unemployment expectations reduce discretionary spending power; cyclical consumer sectors underperform in favor of defensive staples and utilities.

trade_logic.entry: When weekly initial claims exceed 4-week MA by 15% and are above 52-week median
trade_logic.exit: After 2 weeks or when claims drop below 4-week MA

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Jobless claims swing 10–20% weekly due to seasonal adjustments and economic shocks; significant spikes occur 3–5 times per year, often clustering around recessions or policy changes.

idea: Shipping Container Spot Rate Surge Signals Freight Demand Strength

data.source: Drewry World Container Index weekly rates via html_table scrape from public shipping indices

behavior: Weekly spikes in container shipping spot rates (Shanghai to Rotterdam) of 10%+ signal sudden surge in global trade demand and manufacturing activity, bullish for industrials and materials.

market_impact.rationale: Rising shipping rates signal strong export demand and manufacturing strength; industrials and capital equipment suppliers benefit from increased logistics costs passed through supply chains.

trade_logic.entry: When weekly spot rate rises 10%+ from 4-week MA and is above 52-week median
trade_logic.exit: After 3 weeks or when rate falls below entry price by 5%

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Container rates fluctuate 5–15% weekly due to seasonal demand, port congestion, and trade cycles; volatility spikes occur monthly, especially around holiday shipping seasons.

idea: Earnings Call Mention Spike For 'Supply Chain' Language Signals Industrial Headwind Bearish Rotation

data.source: RSS feed count for earnings-related articles mentioning 'supply chain disruption' or 'logistics bottleneck' via rss_count adapter

behavior: Daily RSS article count spikes on supply chain disruption mention in earnings coverage signal executives warning of margin pressure and delivery delays, triggering bearish industrial rotation.

market_impact.rationale: Supply chain warnings in earnings erode profit expectations for manufacturers and logistics firms; industrial sector underperforms as guidance revisions turn negative.

trade_logic.entry: When daily RSS count for 'supply chain disruption earnings' exceeds 50-article threshold and is 30% above 20-day average
trade_logic.exit: After 5 trading days or when RSS count drops below 30 articles for 2 consecutive days

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Earnings seasons (Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4) each trigger 2–4 supply chain warning spikes; off-season surprises add 1–2 monthly occurrences, averaging 3–4 total per month.

idea: Yield Curve Inversion Momentum Reversal Signals Risk-On Sentiment Shift

data.source: FRED series T10Y2Y (10-year minus 2-year yield spread) daily via fred_series adapter

behavior: When yield curve moves from inverted territory (negative spread) back into positive territory by 10+ basis points over 5 trading days, it signals Fed pivot expectations and risk appetite restoration.

market_impact.rationale: Curve normalization from inversion signals lower recession risk and higher growth expectations; technology and growth stocks benefit from lower perceived discount rates.

trade_logic.entry: When T10Y2Y spread rises 10+ basis points in 5-day window and crosses zero moving from negative
trade_logic.exit: After 10 trading days or if spread inverts again by 5+ basis points

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Yield curve inversions and normalizations occur 2–3 times per year during policy uncertainty; 5-day swings of 10+ bps are common during Fed meeting cycles and inflation pivot narratives.

idea: Regional Bank Stock Price Crash Triggers Financial Sector Capitulation Buy Signal

data.source: Yahoo Finance daily prices for regional bank ETF KRE and broad bank ETF XLF via price_only adapter

behavior: When KRE (regional banks) drops 8%+ in 2 trading days relative to XLF, it signals capitulation selling often followed by mean-reversion bounce as oversold conditions trigger value buying.

market_impact.rationale: Regional bank crashes create extreme valuation dislocation; buying pressure from index funds and value investors reverses declines within 5–10 trading days.

trade_logic.entry: When KRE underperforms XLF by 8%+ over 2 trading days and RSI(14) on KRE closes below 30
trade_logic.exit: After 5 trading days or when KRE outperforms XLF by 2% cumulatively

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Regional banking sector experiences 6–10% crashes 2–4 times per year during credit stress events, earnings misses, and rate shock cycles; 2-day 8%+ swings trigger monthly.

idea: EV Charger Installation Pace Acceleration Signals Green Energy Capex Surge Bullish XLE Rotation

data.source: OpenChargeMap charger count by region, updated weekly via openchargemap adapter

behavior: Weekly increases in EV charger count of 5%+ signal accelerating government EV infrastructure spending and private utility capex buildout, supporting energy transition capex demand.

market_impact.rationale: Utilities and energy infrastructure firms benefit from EV charging buildout contracts; legacy energy transition investments create sustained revenue growth in the energy sector.

trade_logic.entry: When weekly EV charger count increases 5%+ from 4-week average and 52-week trend is positive
trade_logic.exit: After 4 weeks or when charger growth rate drops below 2% for 2 consecutive weeks

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: EV charging infrastructure expands in waves tied to federal spending cycles and regional utility programs; 5%+ weekly surges occur 3–5 times annually, especially around legislative action windows.

idea: Crude Oil Volatility Spike Above 25 VIX Equivalent Signals Energy Sector Risk-Off Trade

data.source: Yahoo Finance daily prices for USO (crude oil ETF) and CL=F futures via price_only adapter; calculate 20-day realized volatility

behavior: When crude oil 20-day realized volatility exceeds 25% annualized (equivalent to VIX spike), it signals geopolitical risk or supply shock; energy equities typically underperform during volatility spikes.

market_impact.rationale: Oil price volatility creates margin compression uncertainty for energy producers; equities sell off during high-volatility periods as derivatives hedging costs rise and demand destruction concerns emerge.

trade_logic.entry: When 20-day realized volatility on USO/crude exceeds 25% and closes above prior day close
trade_logic.exit: After 3 trading days or when volatility drops below 20% for 1 trading day

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Crude oil volatility exceeds 25% spikes 4–6 times per year during supply disruptions, geopolitical escalations, and demand shocks; daily triggers average 2–3 per month.
